content.description: Diagram showing evaporator assembly with liquid line tube, pressure switch, expansion valve, and resistor components

items: (a) Remove the heat insulator and the clamp from the outlet tube.
(b) Disconnect the liquid line tube from inlet fitting of the expansion valve.
(c) Disconnect the expansion valve from the inlet fitting of the evaporator.
(d) Remove the pressure switch, if required.

CHECK EVAPORATOR FINS FOR BLOCKAGE
If the fins are clogged, clean them with compressed air.
CAUTION: Never use water to clean the evaporator.

CHECK FITTINGS FOR CRACKS OR SCRATCHES
Repair as necessary.

content.text: Never use water to clean the evaporator.

content.description: Photo showing installation of expansion valve on evaporator with torque specification label

content.text: (a) Connect the expansion valve to the inlet fitting of the evaporator. Torque the nut.

content.component: Expansion valve to evaporator inlet fitting

content.text: Be sure that the O-ring is positioned on the tube fitting.

content.description: Photo showing installation of liquid line tube to expansion valve

content.text: (b) Connect the liquid line tube to the inlet fitting of the expansion valve. Torque the nut.

content.component: Liquid line tube to expansion valve inlet fitting

content.text: (c) Install the pressure switch, if removed.
(d) Install the clamp and heat insulator to the outlet tube.

items: INSTALL UPPER AND LOWER CASES ON EVAPORATOR
